title: Anonymization tool does not recognize the 'U' param in windows
body:
**Description:**
"U" parameter seems not recognized when executing the forget-me.sh script in windows env.

**Affected Product Version**:
EI 6.1.1 update 23

**OS, DB, other environment details and versions**:
Windows 2012 R2
JDK 1.8
DB - h2

**Steps to reproduce**:
1. Start the EI server
2. Create a simple proxy that logs the username coming in the headers.
3. Invoke the proxy
4. Configure forget-me.sh script to replace the log file information (define the pattern in ei-pattern)
5. Execute the forget-me.sh script

**Observations**
Failed to execute the script, as observed the "U" parameter is not recognized.
![sample](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14962228/37089693-782a4df0-2227-11e8-96b8-74931962feab.png)
author: Participant 1
